title: PLAYER 2 HEARS THE PILLBOX, PEDDLER AND SURVIVOR
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, when player 2 walked into reach of THE PILLBOX, up to the Peddler or onto the hidden Survivor, the line went to the host window: the host read THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU from across the map, and player 2, about to be shot, read nothing. The Crier and THE OVERSEER were fixed this way before; these three now are too. Player 2 window says his own line as a short callout (THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU, SURVIVOR FOUND), the host gets TEAMMATE FOUND A SURVIVOR with what he needs, and the Peddler greets each player once.
now: In co-op, the Pillbox warning, the Peddler greeting and the hidden Survivor line go to the player who walked up.

edits.anchor: if(_cd2<e.rng&&!e.sang){ e.sang=1; if(!G.sim){ say('THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU.'); sfx('dish',e.x,e.y); } }
if(k==='big'){ if(mine&&!G.sim) say('Something very large has noticed you.'); return 'mark:big'; }
